name: Modbus
summary: Poll holding and input registers of Modbus TCP devices, or of RTU gateways over TCP, and log one record per device per poll as a durable stream.

settings.name: transport
settings.label: Transport
settings.help: rtu_over_tcp is for a serial gateway that passes RTU frames through a TCP socket.

settings.name: host
settings.label: Device or gateway host
settings.help: More devices are listed in the workflow node or in ingest.json.

egress.note: Each device or gateway you list, on its port. 502 is the Modbus TCP default.

operators.summary: Poll Modbus registers on a schedule and log one record per device per poll as a stream.

implementation.evidence: unit and loopback tests; not run against a real broker, network server or device

notes: The register map is configuration, not code. A value is raw * scale_mul / scale_div in integers. Modbus cannot replay: readings the log refuses wait in a memory queue of 10000 records, then the oldest are dropped and counted. A serial line is reached only through a gateway that passes RTU frames over TCP (O-10 section 2.4.4).
